description: Query the Bancadia registry for business checking account products using compound filter criteria. Returns active, verified listings from financial institutions. Optionally accepts target_industries/target_business_profiles to soft-rank results toward listings built for a given business type or stage — non-matching but eligible listings are still returned, just ranked lower. Each result's application_url is a tracked Bancadia link: give it to the user exactly as returned, including its query string.

accounting_integration_available.description: Whether the account connects to any accounting software (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero)

apy_min.description: Only return accounts whose best available rate (apy_max) is at least this value, as a decimal (e.g. 0.02 = 2%). This is the best rate the account can pay, not what a typical customer gets — many accounts pay less by default. Check apy_default in the results for the standard rate.

available_states.description: Returns listings available in all specified states

entity_types_accepted.description: Returns listings accepting all specified entity types (e.g. llc, s_corp)

expense_integration_available.description: Whether the account connects to any expense/spend-management software

rtp_network.description: Which real-time payment rail is supported

rtp_supported.description: Whether real-time payments (any rail) are supported at all

target_business_profiles.description: Soft-ranks results toward listings built for this business stage/shape. Does not exclude non-matching but otherwise-eligible listings.

items.description: One value from: early_stage_startup (pre-revenue or early-revenue new company), vc_backed (has raised institutional venture funding), bootstrapped_solopreneur (self-funded, one-person or very small team, run as primary full-time work), established_smb (operating business with existing revenue/history), high_growth (rapidly scaling regardless of funding source), side_hustle (part-time/secondary business run alongside other work or a day job).

target_industries.description: Soft-ranks results toward listings built for these business types. Does not exclude non-matching but otherwise-eligible listings.

items.description: One value from: ecommerce (online retail/marketplace sellers), retail_storefront (physical retail location), restaurant_food_service (restaurants, cafes, food trucks), content_creator_solopreneur (creators, influencers, freelance media), professional_services (consultants, agencies, legal/accounting firms), real_estate (agents, property managers, investors), healthcare_practice (clinics, private practices), construction_trades (contractors, tradespeople), trucking_logistics (trucking, freight, logistics), agriculture (farms, agribusiness), saas_tech (software/tech companies), nonprofit (registered nonprofit organizations), small_business_digital_first (general online/no-branch small business with no other single vertical fitting best).

tax_integration_available.description: Whether the account connects to any tax-prep or tax-filing software/service

name: query_business_checking
